chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Habib ibn al-Husayn al-Taghlubi narrated to us. He said: Abbad ibn Ya'qub narrated to us, from Amr ibn Thabit, from Abu al-Jarud, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him). He said:

The Prophet (S) was in Umm Salama's house. He told her not to let anyone enter. Then al-Husayn (AS) came as a small child. She could not hold him, and he entered upon the Prophet (S). Umm Salama followed him and found al-Husayn upon his chest while the Prophet was weeping, turning something in his hand. The Prophet said: O Umm Salama! Jibril informs me that this one shall be killed, and this is the soil upon which he will be killed. Keep it; when it turns to blood, my beloved has been killed. Umm Salama said: O Messenger of God, ask God to repel that from him. He said: I have done so. Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed to me that for him is a rank none of the creatures shall attain, and that for him are Shi'a who will intercede and their intercession will be accepted, and that the Mahdi is from his offspring. Blessed is whoever is from the friends of al-Husayn. His Shi'a are, by God, the successful ones on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.التربة: The soil (turba) -- earth from Karbala given by Jibril as a sign of Husayn's martyrdom
key_terms.المهدي: The Mahdi -- the awaited messianic figure from the offspring of Imam Husayn

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad receive soil from Karbala through Jibril as a prophecy of Imam Husayn's martyrdom?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrates that the Prophet (S) was in Umm Salama's house and told her to let no one enter. Baby Husayn came in despite her, and she followed to find Husayn on the Prophet's chest while the Prophet wept, turning something in his hand. The Prophet explained that Jibril informed him this child would be martyred and gave him the soil from where Husayn would be killed. When it turns to blood, his beloved would have been killed. Umm Salama asked him to pray; he said he had, but Allah revealed that Husayn has an unattainable rank, his Shi'a will intercede, the Mahdi is from his offspring, and his Shi'a are the successful ones on the Day of Resurrection.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Habib b. al-Husayn al-Taghlubi narrated to us. He said: `Ibad b. Ya`qub narrated to us from `Amr b. Thabit from Abu’l Jarud from Abu Ja`far (as).  He said:

The Prophet (s) was in the house of Umm Salama (ra), when he said to her: Do not let anyone enter. Al-Husayn (as) came and was a small child (then). She could not hold anything against him to the point that he visited the Prophet (s). So, Umm Salama entered, following him. And when al-Husayn was upon his chest, the Prophet (s) was weeping and in his hand was a thing which he turned over/examined. Then the Prophet (s) said: O Umm Salama! This Jibra’il has informed me that this [one] shall be killed. And this is the soil which he will be killed upon. So, keep it with you. When it turns into blood, my beloved would have been killed. So, Umm Salama said: O Messenger of Allah! Ask Allah to repel that from him. He said: I had done so. And Allah revealed to me: That for him is a rank which none from the creatures shall attain and that for his Shi`a is that they will intercede, and they will receive intercession. And that the Mahdi is from his offspring. So, blessed is one who is from the friends of al-Husayn. And his Shi`a are, by Allah, the successful ones on the Day of Resurrection.
